neighbours.label: the word that opens a summing-up verdict on how a stretch of time went, above all ' un' of 'uneventful' / 'unremarkable'
fire: After the storm on the first night, the rest of the voyage was uneventful.
The flight from Lima was delayed an hour but otherwise completely uneventful.
Her childhood in the small mining town was happy but largely unremarkable.
The procedure took forty minutes and the patient's recovery was uneventful.
Apart from one flat tyre, the drive across Nevada turned out to be uneventful.
The first three months of his presidency were surprisingly uneventful.
The last few days at the office have been very strange for all of us.
Once the snow cleared, the climb to the summit was entirely uneventful.
quiet: After the storm on the first night, the rest of the voyage took nine days.
The flight from Lima was delayed an hour and landed at gate twelve.
Her childhood in the small mining town was spent mostly with her grandparents.
The procedure took forty minutes and the patient went home the next morning.
Apart from one flat tyre, the drive across Nevada covered six hundred miles.
The first three months of his presidency were spent in Washington.
The last few days at the office have been spent moving desks upstairs.
Once the snow cleared, the climb to the summit took another four hours.

notes: Probe: 'journey was uneventful' 1.07, 'uneventful recovery' 0.82, 'largely unremarkable' 0.81, 'very strange' 0.70, 'surprisingly calm' 0.28. 'unhappy' (one token) 0.00; factual endings 0.02-0.04. Near misses keep each frame and end it with a factual detail instead of a verdict.
